description: This file defines the SequenceUtil class, which manages database sequences for generating unique IDs using sequence banks, with thread-safe operations and database transaction management.

classes.name: SequenceUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing sequences and sequence banks for generating unique IDs.

classes.name: SequenceUtil.SequenceBank
classes.description: Inner class representing a sequence bank that handles batch ID generation with thread safety and database synchronization.

methods.name: SequenceUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing SequenceUtil with helper info and sequence entity model.

methods.name: getNextSeqId
methods.description: Returns the next sequence ID from the sequence bank.

methods.name: forceBankRefresh
methods.description: Forces a refresh of the sequence bank to get new IDs.

methods.name: getBank
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sequence bank for a given sequence name.

methods.name: SequenceBank
methods.description: Inner class managing a batch of sequence IDs, handling database locking, incrementing, and thread safety.

methods.name: getNextSeqId
methods.description: Obtains the next sequence ID, refilling the bank if necessary, with concurrency control.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the sequence bank, resetting current IDs and refilling from the database.

methods.name: fillBank
methods.description: Fills the sequence bank by executing database transactions to lock, read, and increment sequence values.
